name: Brink Sense
description: Feel for the faint pulse of a fallen ally and judge how close to the edge they lie.

name: Cordlife Guard
description: Brace the body with qi so that a mortal blow lands softer than it should.

name: Recoil Fist
description: Strike with a fist that rebounds from the target and lands a second time.

name: Ankle Snare
description: Tug a foe's step off line by tying a thread of qi to the ankle.

name: Edge Mend
description: Close a deep wound with a ring of mending qi so the bleeding stops within a few breaths.

name: Warm Ring
description: Draw the cold of near-death out of an ally's limbs along a ring of warm qi.

name: Lung Recall
description: Call a stopped breath back into an ally who has just fallen, before the pulse is gone.

name: Pulse Relight
description: Restart a halted heart with a pulse of rebirth qi if the ally fell only moments ago.

name: Lives Echo
description: Hear the echo of earlier lives in a foe's breath and guess how they fight.

name: Rebirth Skin
description: Wear a skin of rebirth qi that closes small cuts as quickly as they open.

name: Bygone Dart
description: Throw a dart that carries the weight of many past strikes in a single blow.

name: Another Step
description: Step as another self would, through a gap the present self cannot see.

name: Many Hands
description: Strike with the memory of many lifetimes of blows landing as a flurry from one fist.

name: Rebirth Flush
description: Flush an ally's body with rebirth qi until taint, poison and curse residue wash away.

name: Deep Recall
description: Reach deep into the field to read the history of a body from the qi it holds.

name: Life Renewed
description: Draw a recently fallen ally back from death by pouring a rebirth cycle into the body.

name: Echoing Lives
description: Release echoes of past selves that strike in a wide ring, each landing a blow from its own life.

name: Twin Self
description: Split a step in two and let the foe strike the one left behind.

name: Paired Pulse
description: Pair the user's pulse with an ally's so strength passes from one to the other.

name: Dual Husk
description: Cast two husks round the body, one outer and one inner, each breaking in turn.

name: Hawk Memory
description: See an ally's path ahead from above, as a hawk sees ground it has crossed before.

name: Pair Mend
description: Mend two wounds on one ally at once with paired hands of rebirth qi.

name: Azure Renewal
description: Spread a pale blue renewing glow that lifts poison, taint and fatigue off an ally.

name: Second Self
description: Press paired palms to a fallen ally's chest and bring back the breath that left them.

name: Twin Recoil
description: Take a blow and return it doubled by two hands at once.

name: Hawk Rise
description: Rise above the foe's guard on a burst of renewing qi and land on the far side.

name: Azure Wing
description: Wheel a wing of azure qi round the body to turn a thrust aside.

name: Talon Return
description: Strike with a talon and draw it back to guard faster than the foe's counter.

name: Rebirth Eye
description: Open a sight that sees how near a body is to death or to health.

name: Azure Mend
description: Pour pale blue mending qi into an ally's wound until the flesh knits.

name: Paired Rebirth
description: Link two allies in a ring of rebirth qi so each draws on the other's reserve.

name: Hawk Shriek
description: Loose a sharp hawk cry of qi that jolts the foe's focus.

name: Azure Return
description: Call a newly fallen ally back along a shining thread of azure qi if the thread is cast in time.

name: Rebirth Stoop
description: Fall on the foe in a stoop that spends the user's wounds as force and renews them on landing.

name: Wheel Oath
description: Swear on the turning wheel to keep going and feel the oath steady the limbs.

name: Wind Rebound
description: Turn a blow back on the wind along the same line it came.

name: Bearing Cycle
description: Circle the foe on a held bearing and finish facing the open side.

name: Sworn Sense
description: Sense whether an oath-bound ally is near death or only weary.

name: Open Breath
description: Open the chest of a winded ally and let a wind of renewal fill it.

name: Vowed Blow
description: Strike with the weight of a vow sworn to the wheel, landing harder each time it returns.

name: Oath Return
description: Swear an ally back from the brink by sending the oath after them as a thread of qi.

name: Wheel Reckoning
description: Spin the wheel of qi wide round the user and strike all who stand within its turning.

name: True Bearing
description: Take a true bearing and step through the foe's line to its far side.

name: Wind Shell
description: Wrap the body in a shell of wind-borne rebirth qi that eases blows.

name: Open Pulse
description: Open the senses wide to catch the pulse of every ally and foe nearby.

name: Bearing Flick
description: Flick an oath-marked bead of qi that finds its target by the bearing taken.

name: Sworn Mend
description: Mend a wound on an ally who has sworn to stand again.

name: Bearing Purge
description: Take a bearing on the taint in an ally's blood and draw it straight out.

name: Holding Oath
description: Seal a dying ally's last spark inside the chest so it cannot drain away.

name: Return Bearing
description: Follow the faint bearing of a fallen ally's spirit and call it back to the body.

name: Sworn Cycle
description: Release a wheel of oath-bound qi that sweeps all foes around the user once, then returns.
